about_the_game:
Crafted with love by a brother-sister duo featuring hand-drawn art. This game is a purr-fect blend of chaos, charm, and fun.

Ever dreamed of running a cat rescue business? Dive into Cat Rescue Inc, a quirky casual action-adventure where you stack adorable cats on your head, and bring them to your trusty van while dodging pesky forest critters!

Gameplay

Embark on thrilling missions to save lost cats in randomly generated forests bursting with seasonal vibes—sunny summers, crisp autumns, and snowy winters. Each level challenges you to stack cats (yes, on your head!) while weaving through dangers like sneaky wolves and mischievous critters. Deliver your cat tower to the van to earn cash, climb cat-themed ranks.

Quick missions, simple controls, and a dash of humor make this ideal for casual gamers and cat lovers alike.

You get to keep any loot you might find in your successful missions.

Key Features

  • Stack ‘Em Up! Form a tower of cats on your head—and deliver them to your trusty van!

  • Explore Vibrant Forests: Navigate randomly generated levels with unique seasonal twists.

  • Dodge the Danger: Outsmart wild animals with quick moves!

  • Rank Up: Earn cash to climb ranks, from Newbie to the legendary Lion of Industry!

  • Charming Art: Every cat, tree, and van is drawn by my sister, bringing a cozy, heartfelt vibe to every pixel.

  • Streamer-Friendly: Short missions, funny moments, and shareable rank-ups make it perfect for Twitch or YouTube.

Why You’ll Love It

Whether you’re a cat fanatic or just crave a lighthearted escape, Cat Rescue Inc delivers laughs, quick thrills, and endless feline charm. Stack those cats, dodge those critters, and become the ultimate cat rescuer—paws and all! 😺

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E5200
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 9800GTX+ (1GB)
  • Storage: 256 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
